breakdown.description: Terminal velocity exists because drag balances the net weight; neglecting drag implies continuous acceleration and no finite terminal velocity.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly retains the original error, stating 'The drag force is considered negligible compared to the weight.' The ground truth requires balancing weight minus buoyancy against aerodynamic drag (with C_d = 0.5 and rho_air = 1.2 kg/m^3) to determine terminal velocity. The agent repeated the flawed assumption verbatim instead of correcting it to include drag force in the force balance.
